question: Who threw 90.23 m in javelin at the Doha Diamond League, 2025, setting a record?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, an Indian track and field athlete, achieved a throw of **90.23 meters** in the javelin event at the Doha Diamond League in 2025, setting a new record.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is renowned for his consistent performances in international athletics and is the **first Indian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal in track and field** at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• The Doha Diamond League is one of the most prestigious international track and field competitions, attracting top athletes from around the globe. Neeraj's performance further solidified his status as one of the world's best javelin throwers.
 
• His record-breaking throw at the Doha Diamond League marked a significant milestone in his career and contributed to India's growing recognition in global athletics.
 
• Neeraj Chopra's achievement highlights his dedication, rigorous training, and ability to perform under pressure on the international stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:**

 
 
• He was born on **24 December 1997** in Khandra village, Haryana, India.
 
• Neeraj is a Subedar in the **Indian Army** and is supported by the Mission Olympic Wing of the Indian Army.
 
• He became the **first Indian to win a gold medal in athletics** at the Olympics by throwing a distance of 87.58 meters in the javelin final at the **2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• Neeraj has also won gold medals at the **2018 Commonwealth Games** and the **2018 Asian Games**.
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• It is a track and field event in which athletes throw a spear-like implement called a javelin as far as possible.
 
• The men's javelin weighs **800 grams**, and the women's javelin weighs **600 grams**.
 
• Key factors in achieving a long throw include strength, speed, technique, and timing.
 
 
 
• **Doha Diamond League:**
 
 
• The Diamond League is an annual series of elite track and field competitions organized by **World Athletics**.
 
• The **Doha Diamond League** is usually held in Qatar and serves as the season opener for the Diamond League series.
 
• It features world-class athletes competing in various events, including sprints, middle and long-distance runs, jumping, and throwing events.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Javelin Throwers:**
 
 
• **Shivpal Singh:** He is another prominent Indian javelin thrower who has represented India at various international events.
 
• **Annu Rani:** She is a leading Indian female javelin thrower and has set multiple national records in the event.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Achievements:**

 
 
• He is the **first Indian athlete to win the Diamond League title**, achieving this feat in 2022.
 
• Neeraj holds the **national record** for the javelin throw in India, with a personal best of **89.94 meters** (as of 2023).
 
• He has been awarded prestigious honors such as the **Arjuna Award** (2018) and the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** (2021).
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition of Indian Athletics:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra's achievements have inspired a new generation of Indian athletes to excel in global competitions.
 
• India's performance in athletics has improved significantly in recent years, with more athletes reaching the finals of major international events.
